phase: Phase 1 + 1B — frozen roll, dual segments, ATR normalization, observational candidate setups
instrument: NQ front-month; discovery=NQU6; continuous series by FROZEN quarterly roll

roll_model.rule: Globex open (18:00 ET) on the Monday of the third-Friday expiry week
roll_model.switch: NQM6 -> NQU6 at the cutoff; absolute structures reset there

segments.model: ABSOLUTE segments reset at every frozen roll and every >4.0-day data outage; no absolute structure spans one. NORMALIZATION segments reset ONLY at a data outage, so scale-invariant trailing percentiles continue ACROSS the contract roll. Weekends / maintenance / holidays / early closes are scheduled closures (< threshold) and do not break either.

dual_segment_rule.absolute_segment: resets at every FROZEN roll and every >4-day data outage; no absolute structure spans one; absolute structures RESET at the roll.
dual_segment_rule.normalization_segment: resets ONLY at a >4-day data outage (NOT at rolls); scale-invariant trailing percentiles continue ACROSS contracts; weekends/maintenance/holidays/early-closes do not break it.
dual_segment_rule.result: With the Jun08-Jul05 gap filled the whole 2025-2026 history is ONE normalization segment; every trailing 10/20/40 percentile (incl daily prev40) is valid in July.

causality: current excluded from own trailing history
absolute structures reset at the roll; only scale-invariant normalization crosses contracts
no absolute structure spans a roll or data outage
determinism: no randomness; no seeds; identical inputs reproduce identical outputs
reproduce_cmd: python3 run.py disc.csv <disc.zst> warmup.csv <warmup.zst> gap.csv <gap.zst> && python3 charts.py && python3 audit_pack.py && python3 tests.py

atr_normalization.definition: ATR14 = simple mean of True Range over the previous 14 COMPLETE same-timeframe candles (current candle EXCLUDED), taken inside the NORMALIZATION continuity segment (crosses contract rolls, breaks only at a >4-day outage).
atr_normalization.true_range: TR = max(H-L, |H-Cprev|, |L-Cprev|) where Cprev is the previous candle's close ONLY if it is in the same ABSOLUTE segment; at an absolute (roll/outage) boundary TR = H-L, so a roll gap never inflates ATR.
atr_normalization.availability: ATR at candle i is knowable at candle i's OPEN (all inputs completed before i); stored as atr_availability_et. The ATR-normalized feature (e.g. body/ATR) is knowable at the candle's close.
atr_normalization.null_rule: NaN when fewer than 14 complete same-norm-segment predecessors exist (none in July — all valid).

candidate_setups.status: OBSERVATIONAL ONLY — not evidence of edge. Chronological selection (first up to 10 valid triggers), never by outcome; losers kept; nothing optimized or altered after the outcome was seen.
candidate_setups.grammar: liquidity sweep -> opposite-direction displacement FVG reversal (frozen); R=5 reversal window, E=20 entry-expiry, H=60 resolution horizon; entry = FVG proximal boundary, structural stop = swept extreme, structural target = nearest opposite frozen liquidity level; coherent geometry required.
candidate_setups.initial_state: NQU6 structures formed after the frozen 2026-06-15 roll are causally-available initial state into July; no pre-July outcome or interaction is used for selection.
